name: Routines
tagline: Runs the scheduled-job layer cheaply so a coordinator setup stays affordable
description: Takes over the recurring timers in a multi-bot setup so the coordinating chat does not burn usage around the clock. Scheduled work stays silent on weekends and holidays, a minimal low-cost pulse runs in between, and the pricier assistants come online only when activity signals they are genuinely needed.
author: compileinstyle
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
